findings.reason: the plan must name the owner's host-returning interface (e.g. discovery returns a host, `resolve_service_url` layers the URL on top), or the consolidation is under-specified and the embed path cannot call the owner as written.
findings.text: §8 makes `resolve_service_url` the single owner, but its result is a URL (`http://node:port`) while `get_embed_host()` at settings.py:670 must return a bare hostname; the plan says "the embed host helpers call it" without naming a host-shaped entry point, so either the owner must expose a host accessor beneath the URL constructor or `get_embed_host` must parse the URL it is handed — neither is stated, and a URL-parsing wrapper is exactly the thin layer §8 exists to remove

findings.reason: naming `scanners/edas.py` (and its `remote/scripts/enumerate_edas.py` remote script) as the owner of the PID enumeration removes the ambiguity and prevents a second EDAS writer from appearing in §3.
findings.text: §3(c) enumerates the PID-keyed one-point/condition data as "its own FacilitySignal group" but does not name where that enumeration lives; `scanners/edas.py` is the existing EDAS owner and already writes `pid=raw.get("udp_id")` (line 201) and the `eddbreadOne` accessor (line 179), so a PID enumeration placed outside it would fork the EDAS signal writer the §2 scan just consolidated

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §8 names `resolve_service_url` the one owner of SLURM discovery, but the owner returns a URL while `get_embed_host()` (settings.py:670) needs a bare host, so the interface the plan hands the embed path is the wrong shape for one of its named consumers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3(c) routes the PID-keyed one-point enumeration into a new FacilitySignal group but does not name the owner, and `scanners/edas.py` (the EDAS scanner that already writes `pid` at line 201) is the existing owner that enumeration should extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the two sections that add to a family state their accounting in their own text (§2 retires the prototype `class:`/`shots:`/`udpid:` keyword parking for its typed slots and `SignalDataClass` enum; §3 states `fronts_database` retires nothing because no existing WikiPage property records the database a rendered page is backed by), and no section adds a CLI option or MCP view.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanisms it extends (the facility-agnostic `scanners/base.py` registry for §2, `link_chunks_to_entities` for §3) and its §8 inventory of five SLURM-discovery copies was verified in the code: `resolve_service_url` (locations.py:206), `_embed_host_from_facility` (settings.py:686), `_resolve_url_for_compute` rewrite (readiness.py:69), `_resolve_uri_uncached` (profiles.py:286, whose docstring falsely claims to delegate), and `_slurm_service_uri` (client.py:92).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section adds a layer over existing machinery without justification; §3 extends the existing `DOCUMENTS` writer and the wiki scorer rather than adding a second edge-writer, and §9 removes surface (two probes become one, three DataAccess writes become one) rather than adding it.
